notes.title: Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate is OUT NOW
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/4a4541d5c11d0f52218fad6e8371aae572b16eb2.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111080/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate/

Use magic spells and military surplus explosives to topple an evil crime syndicate hidden beneath a prestigious wizarding school. Learn spells, engage in espionage, and spread lore-unfriendly chaos. 

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/8a10814a7cc6b72e23f82b9f42a3b57ac9509b37.gif

Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate is a comedic sandbox with a complete lack of safety nets or boundaries.  Players are free to indulge in the full abject chaos of untethered physics simulations and uncontainable emergent gameplay, using a toolkit of magical spells and items to solve problems in ways we cannot hope to balance against.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/41808760a60aae8aeb109cad8ea3bb4fddf828b1.gif

Wizard Boy can also team up with other Wizard Boys in cooperative(?) multiplayer to explore (blow up) the castle together and thwart the evil International crime syndicate S.P.I.D.E.R once and for all!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/936ff34a9038dfe99745f535206b311537012ad3.gif

FEATURES

 A multitude of spells to learn and inflict on others
 Chaotic, barely contained physics-based mayhem
 Open-ended goals to accomplish (or ignore) however you see fit
 Online co-op, although actual cooperation is unlikely
 Retro-themed third person action, straight from the days of Unreal Engine 1
 Landmines and other non-magical ordnance


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111080/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate/

notes.title: Butcher's Creek is out now!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/a2a280c65d75ca9252fb955192680d7c1f05a54b.jpg

A troubled loner with a hunger for cinematic gore finds himself on the other side of the camera when rumors of authentic snuff videotapes lead him to an abandoned cabin near Butcher's Creek, Pennsylvania. What starts as illicit urban exploration becomes a fight for survival when he's captured by a gang of sadistic killers. Now his only option is to pick up a box cutter, a hammer, a pickaxe, or whatever else is at hand, and unleash a little video violence of his own.

FEATURES

Use hammers, axes, pipes, 2x4s, box cutters, and more to brutalize anything that stands between you and freedom

When all else fails, the level itself can be a weapon. Kick props into enemies, or enemies into environment hazards.

Photograph gruesome murder scenes to fulfill your dark desires and regain lost health

Explore decaying farmhouses, collapsing factories, and seedy strip clubs in a forgotten corner of the Appalachian Forest

Experience a unique aesthetic combining the gritty shot-on-video look of found footage with the photosourced visual style of Source Engine games

Learn more about the bizarre nightmare world introduced in Squirrel Stapler and The Pony Factory


https://youtu.be/3TLL1g8Z8Y0?si=jCY8kkxFaEhi3XpY
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512560/Butchers_Creek/

notes.title: The Pony Factory is out now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536530/The_Pony_Factory/
Winston arrived at a solution to the moral decay of his town.

He called out to hell, and hell answered. The human body could, hell promised, be twisted and stretched into a kinder, more equine shape. Winston's town, now filled with ignorant hate-mongers, could instead be filled with magical ponies, if he could provide a factory in which to make them. Winston thought they would be beautiful, gentle, and good.

Hell had other plans...

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/f5b229a724a8109c1102ffd3ab63b19ca8c0ae9d.png

The Pony Factory is a short action/horror game inspired by Doom 3, with a darkly comedic story, striking black and white visual style, and visceral FPS gameplay. This is an updated standalone release of the original game, which was created in 7 days as part of the Dread X Collection 1.

FEATURES

Meaty FPS combat against highly agile foes who will attempt to evade and flank you.
Darkness is your enemy!  Use muzzle flashes, sparks, sound, and other clues to track foes during combat.
High contrast black and white aesthetic inspired by early 1950's science fiction films.
A short minimalist campaign that can be completed in about 30 minutes.
Numerous improvements from the original release, including many new quality of life features, balance and game feel improvements, new story and gameplay content, full gamepad support, and of course bugfixes!


https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/95215f003c102674f4b81e4e08fa0ab9bbb4d4dc.png

My brother John Szymanski (director of My Friendly Neighborhood) assisted with this version and will be receiving half of the royalties in an effort to provide him with enough income to continue game development until he begins receiving money from MFN.

John also released his own game today: a tense puzzle/horror game called Exiled:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741620/Exiled/

Both games can be purchased as a bundle together too!

notes.title: The Cheats Update, and Upcoming Price Change
notes.content:
Cheats Update!

As of today, Iron Lung now has a few fun cheats for you to try!  To activate a cheat, type the appropriate command into the computer terminal at the back of the sub.  Cheats can be stacked (if you dare).  There are only a few at the moment but I hope to add some more later on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/a6d6cd41726b28a1422b30508b0e1c35e3dbe7c8.jpg

Currently, you can use the following cheats (which are also listed in cheats.txt in the game's install folder):

 chclear - clears all cheats
 chnoir - activates black and white visual mode
 chview - allows you to see out the front porthole
 chrave - makes the lighting more colorful
 chava - adds a speaker to the Iron Lung
 chvest - gives you a light
 chmark - activates 'Markiplier Mode'


Halloween Sale

Iron Lung is going to be 20% off as part of Steam's Halloween sale, which starts on October 26th and ends on Novermber 2nd.  This is a great time to tell your friends to pick it up because...

Price Change

...after the end of the Halloween sale on Nov. 2, Iron Lung's price will be changing from $6 to $8, and I want to make sure everyone has ample warning and time to buy it at the current price.

This is the only price increase I plan on doing for Iron Lung (I believe any more than $8 would be unfair), and as before all subsequent updates and DLC will be free.  That includes a large collection of behind the scenes photos I plan on releasing as DLC once the movie is out.

When I first released Iron Lung I wasn't confident that people would resonate with the odd concept, and I expected to simply release it and move on.  Now that the game has seen (and will probably continue to see) updates in content, features, and usability, I believe $8 is a fairer price, more in line with what similar horror games ask, and more sustainable for me over the long run.

Since my intent here is not to gouge people for money, but rather to make sure Iron Lung is priced competitively for the long haul, I again want to emphasize that if you know anyone who might want Iron Lung in the near future, make sure they know to grab it during the Halloween sale from Oct. 26th to Nov. 2nd.

notes.title: Lore Update, Achievements, and Points Shop!
notes.content:
HOORAY AN UPDATE!
Here's the first large-scale update to Iron Lung, bringing it to version 2.X.  I say "first" but truthfully this will likely be the only major content update for the game, other than potential (potential, not promised!) future quality of life updates such as controller support, subtitles, etc.

WARNING: OLD SAVES WILL NOT WORK (SEE BELOW)

MORE LORE
So what does this update bring?  Well, first and foremost STORY STUFF.  In the form of the C.O.I Informational Terminal, now located in the back of the sub.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/a152c9907039339080e7e3344c3f136ed42f4ca6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/81a822cf7b5e3e2c9d275afb1f053a62710cba52.jpg

Here you can query various informational documents and learn a little more about the world of Iron Lung.  Not a lot mind you.  This is not a giant lore bible dump.  It's just a way of fleshing things out a bit more than not at all, and maybe giving you some clues about who you are, why you're down there, who sent you, etc.  Go ahead and type in whatever you want to learn about, and see if it finds anything!

There's also something new to find out in the depths of the blood ocean...

POINTS SHOP AND TRADING CARDS
I'm also excited to bring you both Steam trading cards (which I know you will just sell for wallet funds to buy hentai match 3 games instead of actually crafting into badges, but that's ok) and points shop items, including this awesome animated profile background by Dusk comic artist Jacob:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/259969e5deb4b8318b493fa0ed6b3be185320fdf.jpg
animation not shown here

ACHIEVEMENTS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/d46fc9b414f6224ed31d44baade8c72a9f0c49f8.png

And if you feel like playing through the whole game again, there are now 7 Steam achievements for you to unlock.  Most of these are pretty simple and just for fun, but there are two secret ones for those that really want to delve into the game and find/try things.  Or, you know... read someone else's guide lol.

A NOTE ABOUT SAVES
For stupid but unavoidable reasons, saves from a previous version of Iron Lung will not work after this update.  For most of you this isn't going to be an issue, but if you happen to have like... saved your game last night and want to continue today or something like that, I've provided a new branch you can use to finish your game.  Simply opt into the "save_compatibility" beta branch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/7901921b167bf8df817b41661d2dfd089a57ac6e.png

WHAT'S NEXT?
I don't plan on adding any more lore or major content to Iron Lung after this, but for those who have been asking... yes, I do plan on revisiting the world in the future.  I don't know whether that will be a direct followup or a completely different game set in the same universe.  I have ideas for both!  Only time will tell...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41806420/8eb959bb408e548235215071cc2bde908ce5f8c0.png

Thanks again for all the support, and stay safe out there in the Blood Ocean...

notes.title: Iron Lung version 2.0 on beta branch
notes.content:
The upcoming 2.0 patch for Iron Lung is now on the beta branch, for anyone who wishes to help test it.  I expect to release it for realsies in a few weeks, if you wanna wait, but if you're eager to see the changes now or grab the achievements before anyone else, well... go nuts!

Note that OLD SAVES WILL NOT WORK.  This is for stupid but unavoidable reasons.  When this releases officially I'll provide a version 1.2 branch for a few weeks that players can opt into if the update happens right in the middle of their playthrough and they want to continue with their existing save.

And of course if you encounter any issues, please report them on the forum (and specify that you're testing the beta branch)

Thanks!

notes.title: Beta branch
notes.content:
I've added a beta branch to Iron Lung (called, appropriately enough, "beta").  The purpose will be for testing patches before I release them, to make sure I didn't screw something up.  

If you'd like to help test Iron Lung, or if you just want to see what new stuff is coming, you can opt in to the beta branch by right clicking on the game in your library, selecting "properties," choosing the "betas" tab, and selecting "beta" from the dropdown list.

Currently patch 1.2 is on the beta branch, which includes fixes for two of the game's biggest bugs (the loading softlock and incorrect resolution defaults for some players), as well as some new behind the scenes shots in the goodies folder.  Refer to readme.txt for more info.

If you encounter any issues please report them on the forums, and make sure to specify what version you've been playing.

Thanks!

- David

notes.title: Iron Lung is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Pilot a tiny submarine through an ocean of blood on an alien moon in Iron Lung, a short dread-driven underwater (underblood?) horror game

OUT NOW

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1846170/Iron_Lung/

Set entirely within a claustrophobic one-man submarine nicknamed the "Iron Lung," you must blindly navigate an ocean of blood to take photographs of key locations, and hope whatever lives below doesn't find you.
There is only a single porthole on the sub, and it needs to be closed due to depth pressure, so you have to navigate purely via an incomplete map, proximity sensors, sound, and a primitive external camera which can be used to take the pictures you need to complete your mission, or to get a grainy low resolution visual of what's happening outside.

Success will require resourcefulness and patience.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34055240/7bbf04170ab9a9b3b990f9d15af65a7c002ae7f1.png

FEATURES

Experimental minimalist gameplay, where your senses are limited and anything could be lurking around you
Glimpse your surroundings through the lens of a grainy still camera and navigate using an incomplete satellite map and proximity sensors
Horror based around building dread and paranoia
Original soundtrack inspired by the work of Aubrey Hodges (Doom 64)
A short experience intended to be finished in under an hour


https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34055240/ff693bc80fa81dae5d2f799d259307870cce45c6.png

Soundtrack also available at https://davidszymanski.bandcamp.com/album/iron-lung-ost
